column1: # Draft rows for data/asset_indication_additions.csv (append below its header; same columns).
# Written 2026-11-16. Every registry fact is from clinicaltrials.gov API v2 read on 2026-11-16.
# Rows 1 to 7 are task 1 verdict (a): a readout in the indication the asset's forecast values.
# Row 8 (AZURE-LDL) is not one of the thirteen but is the same failure on the seed's own gate study.
# Rows 9 to 11 are task 2: they give felzartamab and afimkibart a Phase 3 pair
# holding them at Phase 2 (afimkibart's Crohn row also needs the override in

column2: because a curated row never raises an existing pair's phase).

column6: OCEAN(a)-Outcomes (Amgen, Phase 3, 7,297 enrolled, randomised and double-blind against placebo) enrols adults aged 18 to 85 with 'Lp(a) ≥ 200 nmol/L during screening' and a history of myocardial infarction or coronary revascularisation, with primary outcome 'Time to CHD death, myocardial infarction, or urgent coronary revascularization, whichever occurs first' and primary completion 2028-03-31 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). The sponsor files one condition, 'Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease', and the registry indexes it only under Atherosclerosis (D050197), which the condition-word rule does not match, so the readout fell through. It is the population the model values: data/assumptions/olpasiran.csv carries Cardiovascular Diseases with eligible_pct 0.09 sourced as 'OCEAN(a) enrols established ASCVD with Lp(a) at 200 nmol/L or above'. The pair is Cardiovascular Diseases (D002318), the asset's lead indication, where the imaging study NCT07293260 already reads out.

AZURE-HeFH (AstraZeneca, Phase 3, 473 enrolled, randomised against placebo, US among 24 countries) enrols adults with a 'Diagnosis of HeFH by genetic confirmation or a definite clinical diagnosis' and LDL-C of at least 55 mg/dL with clinical ASCVD or 70 mg/dL without, primary outcome 'Relative change in LDL-C from baseline to 12 weeks', primary completion 2027-01-04 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Its one condition, 'Heterozygous Familial Hypercholesterolaemia', carries no MeSH indexing, so nothing could match it. Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia is a form of hypercholesterolaemia and the study tests the same LDL-C claim as AZURE-LDL, which data/assumptions/azn_azd0780.csv values on Hypercholesterolemia; BROOKLYN, NAMS obicetrapib's HeFH study, is filed on the same pair in this file. The pair is Hypercholesterolemia (D006937). The seed's pool is adults with clinical ASCVD, so HeFH patients without it sit outside the pool; the study decides the drug's LDL-C effect, which is the gate, not the size of the pool.

Two Phase 3s of the fixed-dose combination of laroprovstat (AZD0780, data/asset_alias_map.csv) with rosuvastatin, both with US sites and primary outcome 'Relative change in LDL-C at 8 weeks' (registry, checked 2026-11-16). NCT07619118 compares it with rosuvastatin alone in patients on a maximally tolerated statin with clinical ASCVD or at increased risk of a first event (200 planned, primary completion 2027-05-28). NCT07619131 is a factorial against laroprovstat alone, rosuvastatin alone and placebo in lipid-lowering-naive patients with no clinical ASCVD and a low 10-year risk (600 planned, 2027-07-30). Each files 'Hypercholesterolaemia' and is indexed under Hypercholesterolemia (D006937); the British spelling is the only reason the condition-word rule missed, because indication_mapping._SPELLING has no entry for it. The third study of the same design, NCT07930507, files 'Hypercholesterolemia' and is already matched to this pair and priced as the asset's gate, so the book already reads the combination programme as a readout in the indication it values. The pair is Hypercholesterolemia (D006937).

Embold (AstraZeneca, Phase 3 master protocol, 4,500 planned, randomised and blinded against placebo, US among 19 countries) is titled for 'Participants With Obesity or Overweight With or Without Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus'. Study 1 enrols 'BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2' or 25 to 30 with a weight-related comorbidity and excludes diabetes; Study 2 enrols BMI ≥ 25 with type 2 diabetes. The primary outcome is 'Percent body weight loss' at 72 weeks and primary completion 2028-07-31 (registry, checked 2026-11-16), so it is a weight readout and not an allocation record. The only condition filed is 'Weight Management', with no MeSH indexing. data/assumptions/azn_elecoglipron.csv values chronic weight management on Obesity ('the label criterion is the prevalence threshold, BMI 30 or 27 with a comorbidity'), and attach_catalyst_indications already reads obesity-or-overweight studies as obesity readouts (_NARROWS_TO). The pair is Obesity (D009765).

The seed values this study's population on this row: data/assumptions/lly_ly4065967.csv states 'Modelled: US diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain (DPNP) on the book's 'Chronic Pain' row, which holds the DPNP study as the asset's lead indication'. NCT07285018 (Lilly chronic pain master protocol, study NP07, Phase 2, 150 planned, randomised and double-blind against placebo, US and Puerto Rico) enrols adults with symmetrical diabetic peripheral neuropathy for at least 6 months, primary outcome 'Change from Baseline in Average Pain Intensity as Measured by the Numeric Rating Scale (NRS)' at week 8, primary completion 2027-07 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Its one condition, 'Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathic Pain', has no MeSH indexing. MeSH's own descriptor is Diabetic Neuropathies (D003929, id.nlm.nih.gov lookup checked 2026-11-16), which the asset does not hold, and filing it there would put the modelled study on a row with no assumptions. The pair is Chronic Pain (D059350).

MEVPRO-2 (Pfizer, Phase 3, 900 planned, randomised and quadruple-blind, mevrometostat with enzalutamide against placebo with enzalutamide) enrols men with prostate adenocarcinoma, metastases on bone scan or CT/MRI and 'Progressive disease in the setting of medical or surgical castration', primary outcome 'Radiographic Progression Free Survival (rPFS)', primary completion 2027-09-30 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Its one condition, 'Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer', has no MeSH indexing. data/assumptions/pfe_mevrometostat.csv values this line, 'ARPI-naive first line on Prostatic Neoplasms, Castration-Resistant', and names MEVPRO-2 as its study. The pair is Prostatic Neoplasms, Castration-Resistant (D064129, id.nlm.nih.gov lookup checked 2026-11-16). The asset holds base assumption rows on that indication but no pair for it, because no study was indexed there; this row makes the pair, at Phase 3 from MEVPRO-2.

Four Phase 3s of PCV21 in healthy infants aged 42 to 89 days (42 to 112 in NCT06975878), each randomised and active-controlled against a licensed conjugate vaccine (registry, checked 2026-11-16): NCT06736041 against 20vPCV, primary outcomes seroresponse and IgG for the PCV21 serotypes 30 days after doses 3 and 4 (1,714 enrolled, primary completion 2027-05-17); NCT06975878 against 15vPCV, the same measures after the toddler dose (1,092, 2027-08-25); NCT06824194, the safety study against 20vPCV (2,360, 2027-10-22); and NCT06824181, mixed 20vPCV and PCV21 schedules with safety and IgG primary outcomes (580, 2027-09-10). Each files 'Pneumococcal Immunization' with no MeSH indexing. data/assumptions/sny_pcv21.csv values a paediatric market on Pneumococcal Infections ('Every one of the seven Phase 3 trials on the asset is pediatric'), and the catch-up study NCT06838000, indexed under Pneumococcal Infections (D011008), already prices the gate on that row. The pair is Pneumococcal Infections (D011008). data/paediatric_indications.csv names the same four studies on the 'Pediatric pneumococcal infections' row, which has no descriptor and no assumptions, so it cannot make the readouts ones the forecast values; the catalyst link stays on that row because sub-population rows are read first.

AZURE-LDL, the study data/assumptions/azn_azd0780.csv names as the asset's Phase 3 ('Phase 3 AZURE-LDL (3,103 patients, primary completion 11 January 2027)'). The registry (checked 2026-11-16) gives 3,103 enrolled, randomised and double-blind against placebo, in patients with elevated LDL-C and clinical ASCVD or at risk for a first ASCVD event, primary outcome 'Relative change in LDL-C from baseline to 12 weeks', primary completion 2027-01-11. The sponsor files the condition 'Cardiovascular Disease' and the registry indexes Cardiovascular Diseases (D002318) and Atherosclerosis, so the book reads the readout as one in Cardiovascular Diseases, which the forecast does not value, and prices the gate on a fixed-dose combination study (NCT07930507, 2027-10-11) instead. The study's claim is LDL-C lowering, which is the Hypercholesterolemia row the seed values. The pair is Hypercholesterolemia (D006937).

PREVAIL (NCT06935357, Biogen, Phase 3, 454 planned, randomised and quadruple-blind against placebo, started 2025-05-08, recruiting) enrols adults with biopsy-confirmed IgA nephropathy and proteinuria of at least 1.0 g/day on a maximally tolerated ACE inhibitor or ARB, primary outcome 'Percent Change From Baseline in Proteinuria as Measured by the Urine Protein: Creatinine Ratio (UPCR)' to week 36, primary completion 2027-05-31; NCT07889362 is a 25-patient Phase 2 in the same disease, not yet recruiting, primary outcome change in mesangial IgA deposition (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Both are indexed under Glomerulonephritis, IGA (D005922), but the sponsor writes 'Immunoglobulin A Nephropathy', which shares no word with the descriptor, so neither made a pair and the book holds the asset at the Phase 2 of its only pair, Graves Disease. Biogen's FY2025 10-K (0000875045-26-000013) reports milestone payments to MorphoSys 'upon the first patient dosed in a Phase 3 clinical trial of felzartamab for the treatment of AMR and IgAN'. data/assumptions/biib_felzartamab.csv values US IgA nephropathy only on this indication and says the engine 'reads Phase 2 because the book's asset_indications holds only Graves' disease for this asset'. The pair is Glomerulonephritis, IGA (D005922).

Three Phase 3s of afimkibart in adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, each randomised and blinded against placebo (registry, checked 2026-11-16): AMETRINE-1 (NCT06589986, induction and treat-through maintenance, 400 planned, started 2024-09-17, active not recruiting, primary outcomes clinical remission at weeks 12 and 52, primary completion 2027-01-30), AMETRINE-2 (NCT06588855, induction, 350 planned, started 2024-12-11, active not recruiting, clinical remission, primary completion 2026-10-29) and AMETRINE-SC (NCT07846683, subcutaneous induction, 350 planned, start 2026-11-15, recruiting, clinical remission at week 12, primary completion 2028-05-31). The sponsor files 'Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis' and the registry indexes none of them, so the asset has no ulcerative colitis pair and the book holds it at Phase 2, the phase of its atopic dermatitis, rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn rows. data/assumptions/rog_afimkibart.csv values Colitis, Ulcerative and names AMETRINE-1 and AMETRINE-2 as its Phase 3. The paediatric Phase 3 NCT07158242 is not named, so its readout does not land on the adult row. The pair is Colitis, Ulcerative (D003093).

SIBERITE-1 (NCT06819878, induction and maintenance, 600 planned, started 2025-03-17) and SIBERITE-2 (NCT06819891, induction, 425 planned, started 2025-05-12) are Phase 3s of afimkibart in moderately to severely active Crohn's disease, both recruiting, with primary outcomes clinical remission by Crohn's Disease Activity Index and endoscopic response and primary completion 2028-12-31 (registry, checked 2026-11-16). Neither is indexed, so the asset's Crohn Disease pair comes only from the Phase 2 NCT05910528 and stands at Phase 2. data/assumptions/rog_afimkibart.csv values Crohn Disease and names both studies. The pair is Crohn Disease (D003424); because the pair already exists, the build keeps its Phase 2 and the phase needs the companion override row. The paediatric Phase 3 NCT07298421 is not named.
